# AMD AMF API headers

Headers only from [AMD AMF SDK v1.4.36](https://github.com/GPUOpen-LibrariesAndSDKs/AMF/tree/16f7d73e0b45c473e903e46981ed0b91efc4c091), commit `16f7d73e0b45c473e903e46981ed0b91efc4c091`. Original copyright and license notices are retained. Only the transitive API headers required by our encoder adapter are included; no SDK sample implementation, FFmpeg library or driver binary is bundled.

The Windows adapter loads the installed graphics driver runtime from the system directory.
